title: Add golden-run diff dashboard and oncall triage hub for per-route latency/cost regressions
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds a Golden-Run diff layer to the Console and an oncall triage hub service to speed SLO RCA for per-route latency/cost regressions. Includes runbook links and weighted log snippets to accelerate incident response.
commits: d4b9f3f: feat(obs-triage): add triage hub skeleton and golden-run ingestion API
a7c0e2b: feat(console): golden-run diff dashboard panels and timeline widgets
f1e7bad: feat(telemetry): add weighted-log-sampler and representative-snippet extraction
8b2c114: test: e2e for golden-run ingestion + diff generation; add fixture data
body:
Context: On-call teams frequently spend the first 10-30 minutes of an incident assembling what 'normal' looks like for the impacted route and then hunting for the earliest divergence. We built a lightweight Golden-Run diff flow and an oncall triage hub to compress that work into a few clicks.

What this PR does (single continuous description): Adds an 'obs-triage-hub' microservice that ingests golden-run artifacts (serialized invocation profiles produced by our synthetic-runner), computes per-route delta rollups (latency percentiles, token-cost, kernel queue indicators, KV cache hit rate), and stores compact diff summaries for fast query. Exposes a small HTTP API for: (1) registerGoldenRun, (2) computeDiffAgainstBaseline, (3) fetchRepresentativeSnippets for a route/time-window. Adds a weighted-log-sampler that scores candidate log lines by a combination of severity, uniqueness, and token-density to return 3–5 representative snippets per diff that are surfaced in Console.

In Console: introduces a new 'Golden Run diff' dashboard (console/dashboards/golden_run_diff.json) and a timeline component (diff_timeline.tsx) that overlays current metric stream against baseline percentiles and highlights the first divergent segment. Each diff tile includes direct links to: the runbook (runbooks/golden_run_triage.md), the triage hub API trace, and a pre-populated PagerDuty annotation template.

Operational safeguards: added a noise gate that ignores diffs driven by low-volume routes (threshold configured via feature flag) and a cardinality guard to downsample routes with high tag cardinality prior to diff computation.

Checklist:
- [x] design doc + Linear: ENG-4218
- [x] triage hub service with ingestion API and diff runner
- [x] console dashboard + timeline widget
- [x] weighted log sampler and snippet extractor
- [x] runbook with triage steps and PagerDuty templates
- [x] e2e test harness and fixture data (ci/e2e/golden_run)
- [x] CI passes and manual smoke test on staging

Commits (high-level): d4b9f3f adds the hub skeleton and API; a7c0e2b wires dashboard panels and console plumbing; f1e7bad implements the heuristic sampler and snippet extraction; 8b2c114 adds an e2e fixture and test asserting diff outputs remain stable for the canonical golden run.

Files changed (high level): see changed_files list — notable additions are the diff runner (observability/triage-hub/internal/diff/runner.go), the snippet extractor (telemetry/logsampler/snippet_extractor.go), and the console JSON dashboard. The dashboard layout is intentionally compact to avoid query explosion; it uses precomputed compact diff summaries served by the triage hub instead of joining raw timeseries in the browser.

Review conversation summary: 
- Tom Barlow (review): requested that the diff payload include the model variant and quantization tag to help explain cost deltas. Action: added those metadata fields to the ingest API (d4b9f3f).
- Evelyn Zhang (review): observed high tag cardinality in early runs; asked for a fallback to coarse-grained route buckets and a sampling cap. Action: implemented route-bucket hashing and a per-tenant cap with an opt-in precise mode (f1e7bad). Evelyn approved after smoke tests.
- Marcus Holt (review): asked for a test covering the snippet extractor's dedup heuristic to avoid surfacing repeated log frames; author added unit tests and an e2e that asserts non-duplicated snippets in the returned set (8b2c114).

CI summary: Initial run failed in linters (gofmt) and a flaky e2e (timing-dependent). Fixes: applied formatting and hardened e2e timing to use deterministic fixture timestamps. Final CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, e2e).

Operational notes & rollout: feature gated behind 'golden_run_diff' feature flag. Staged rollout: enabled for staging tenants on 2025-11-05, small cohort of production tenants 2025-11-09, full rollout 2025-11-11. Monitored: per-route diff compute latency, diff queue length, and sampler error rate. Added alert: obs.triage.diff.compute.latency.p95 > 2s for 5m -> page SRE.

Runbook excerpt (runbooks/golden_run_triage.md): first step: fetch golden-run diff for route -> if diff shows latency increase >20 ppoints and token-cost > 15% -> fetch representative snippets -> check kernel queue and kv cache hit rate panels -> if kernel queue elevated, escalate to infra; otherwise continue model/config/traffic RCA.

Merge: approved by Evelyn Zhang and Marcus Holt. Squashed and merged into main on 2025-11-12.

Notes for follow-ups (future PRs):
- persistence compaction for multi-day golden-run archives (ENG-4270)
- UI: enable side-by-side prompt-level diff view if customers opt-in
- Telemetry: add a token-weighted delta to better surface cost regressions originating from prompt growth rather than model behavior

If you want to exercise the flow locally: see observability/triage-hub/README.md for quickstart and the e2e fixture at ci/e2e/golden_run/fixture.yaml.
